title: Northgate Protect Complete Monthly Alongside Single-Item Plans: Overlap and Liability per Item
content:
Northgate Protect Complete Monthly and single-item plans are mutually exclusive for any one item. An item that has an active single-item plan is not registered on the customer's Complete Monthly plan while that plan is active, and becomes registrable on the day after the single-item plan ends. A claim for an item is filed on the plan on which the item is registered and never on both. On Complete Monthly the limit of liability is held per item: each registered item adds its net price to the remaining limit of liability, and a settlement on one item reduces only that item's share, which is that item's net price minus earlier settlements on it.

## Points of judgement

| Item's position | Registrable on Complete Monthly? | Plan a claim is filed on |
|---|---|---|
| Has an active single-item plan | No, while that single-item plan is active | The single-item plan |
| Its single-item plan ended | Yes, from the day after the single-item plan ended | Complete Monthly, once registered there |
| Never had a single-item plan | Registered under the Complete Monthly coverage rules | Complete Monthly |

- *Hypothetical:* a single-item plan on a laptop ends on 3 March; the laptop becomes registrable on Complete Monthly on 4 March, not on 3 March.
- *Hypothetical, per-item share:* Complete Monthly carries a $600.00 television and a $300.00 console; a $150.00 settlement on the television leaves the television's share at $450.00 and the console's share at $300.00.
